nodes.name: Calcination of RuCl3
nodes.procedure: First, 0.5 mmol of RuCl3 was dissolved in 4 mL of absolute ethanol, and then the solution was mixed well by stirring. The product was collected by heating to 600°C using a muffle furnace at a ramp rate of 5°C/min for 120 min and then cooling to room temperature at a ramp rate of 5°C/min.
nodes.source_text: First, 0.5 mmol of RuCl3 was dissolved in 4 mL of absolute ethanol... cooling to room temperature at a ramp rate of 5°C/min.

nodes.name: Doping calcination R·RuOx and Se-RuOx-y
nodes.procedure: The synthesis of R·RuOx (R = P, S, N, Se) followed the same procedure as the RuO2 synthesis method (0.5 mmol RuCl3 dissolved in 4 mL absolute ethanol, stirred, then heated to 600°C at 5°C/min for 120 min, cooled at 5°C/min), with an additional 0.02 mmol of Se (or S, CH4N2O, NaH2PO2) in anhydrous ethanol. For Se-RuOx-y (y=1,2,4,6), different Se powder contents (0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.06 mmol) were used following the same procedure.
nodes.source_text: The synthesis of R·RuOx followed the same procedure as the previously described synthesis method, with an additional 0.02 mmol of Se... with different Se powder contents (0.01, 0.02, 0.04 and 0.06 mmol...)

nodes.description: OER performance in 0.5 M H2SO4 three-electrode system

catalyst_loading.value: 3 mg/600 μL Nafion solution, 21 μL deposited

nodes.source_text: The electrochemical OER performance of the R·RuOx electrocatalyst was assessed by a standard three-electrode system in a 0.5 M H2SO4 electrolyte... Se·RuOx displays notable catalytic activity... smallest required overpotential of 188 mV to deliver 10 mA cm−2... Tafel slope (64.6 mV dec−1)... Cdl of Se·RuOx is 64.7 mF cm−2... fully retained activity following 1000 CV cycles... nearly unaltered OER performance during... 150 h at 100 mA cm−2... low dissolution rates of 0.91% for Ru and 2.29% for Se after 100 h stability testing, with the stability number (S-number) determined to be 2.2×10^5.

A membrane electrode assembly (MEA)-based PEMWE was constructed with Se·RuOx as the anode catalyst... to reach a water-splitting current density of 1 A cm−2, the Se·RuOx-based PEMWE required a full-cell voltage of 1.84 V... When the temperature reaches 80 °C... the full-cell voltage of the Se·RuOx-based PEMWE is 1.59 V at 0.5 A cm−2, 1.67 at 1 A cm−2 and 1.74 V at 1.5 A cm−2... the Se·RuOx-based PEMWE can operate stably for 1000 h, with a degradation rate of only 58 μV h−1.

nodes.characterization_summary: All catalysts display peaks matching RuO2 phase (JCPDS No. 40-1290); R·RuOx peaks shift to lower angles indicating successful doping without structural damage.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurement was conducted to identify the phase information for all the catalysts. As shown in Fig. 1a, b, all the XRD patterns display the same group of peaks in agreement with the ${ \mathrm { R u O } } _ { 2 }$ phase (JCPDS No. 40-1290).

nodes.characterization_summary: Se·RuOx nanoparticles have average diameter of 10 nm with interplanar spacings of 0.32 nm (110) and 0.26 nm (101) of FCC RuO2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ${ \mathsf { S e } } { \cdot } { \mathsf { R u O } } _ { \mathbf { x } }$ nanoparticles with an average diameter of 10 nm were further determined from HAADF-STEM images, as shown in Fig. 1e and Fig. S6. The high-resolution TEM images obtained via spherical aberration correction show interplanar spacings of 0.32 and $0 . 2 6 \mathsf { n m }$ , which correspond to the (110) and (101) lattice fringes of face-centred cubic (FCC) ${ \sf R u O } _ { 2 }$ (Fig. 1f–h).
